message.content:
The value of $20 in British Pounds depends on the current exchange rate, which fluctuates daily. As of the most recent rates, 1 USD ≈ 0.78 GBP. Using that rate:

\[
\$20 \times 0.78 \text{ GBP/USD} \approx £15.60
\]

So, roughly, $20 is about £15.5–£16. Keep in mind that the exact amount can vary slightly depending on the day’s rate and any fees your bank or service may charge.
